diagnoses.test: sign up and sign in > new visitor signs up and lands on the home page signed in
diagnoses.cause: The global expect timeout was set to 1 ms, causing the toHaveURL assertion to time out before the navigation completes.

diagnoses.test: sign up and sign in > existing user signs in

diagnoses.test: sign up and sign in > wrong password keeps the user on the sign in page with an error
diagnoses.cause: With a 1 ms expect timeout, the error message is not captured in time, leading to a toContainText failure.
diagnoses.check_first: Check the `expect: { timeout: 1 }` configuration in playwright.config.ts and increase the timeout to allow UI updates to be detected.
